title: '90s Bands: 30 Favorites in Alt Rock, Grunge, Pop, R&B, Metal, and More
content:
The 1990s were loud. Messy. Iconic. And '90s bands didn’t just make music; they rewrote the rulebook.
With grunge in the garage, nu metal in the pit, and industrial rock lighting up underground clubs, this was the decade when genres collided and rock fans had it all.
Advertisement
Some bands came screaming out of the gate. Others simmered, slow-burning their way to massive success. Here’s a look at the biggest bands that made '90s music unforgettable.
